description: This Go source file implements a command-line application using the Bubble Tea framework. It creates a UI component with a tree structure where nodes contain text input elements, and it initializes the tree with predefined nodes. The program handles key events like quitting and renders the tree within styled borders.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application; initializes and starts the Bubble Tea program.

methods.name: newModel
methods.description: Creates and initializes the application model, including setting up the tree nodes with text inputs.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the model and returns a blinking cursor command.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and updates the model state accordingly, including handling quit commands.

methods.name: View
methods.description: Renders the entire UI as a string for display.
